senses.gloss:
तुज्,
तुञ्ज् 1 P. (तुञ्जति; also Ā. and 10 P.) Ved. 
__1 To reach, extend, convey. 
__2 To kill, hurt, injure. 
__3 To guard, protect. 
__4 To clothe. 
__5 To live. 
__6 To strike, hit. 
__7 To push. 
__8 To emit, send forth. 
__9 To incite, instigate, urge onwards. 
__10 To give. 
__11 To press out. 
__12 To flow forth; सुरेतसा श्रबसा तुञ्जमाना [[Rv. 3. 1. 16.]]

तुज,
तुञ्ज a. Ved. Noxious, mischievous, hurtful. 
-जः 
__1 A shock, assault; तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे [[Rv. 1. 7. 7.]] 
__2 A demon; यात किं विदिशो जेतुं तुञ्जेशो दिवि किं तया [[Ki. 15. 18.]] 
__3 A thunderbolt. 
__4 Giving. 
__5 Pressure.
